name: neon-studio
label: Neon Studio
description: Full-frame graphics for the Neon Video Studio episode, in the app's own neon look.
author: Joe Lloyd

templates.name: NeonBackground
templates.label: Neon background
templates.description: Near-black with a grid, a timeline ruler, a sweeping playhead and a running timecode. Put one clip under the whole video.

templates.name: NeonStage
templates.label: Neon stage
templates.description: One full-frame graphic: chapter, title and a scene built from Items. Every word on screen is a field.

fields.label: Chapter
fields.description: The part this shot belongs to, top right, e.g. 04 / The CLI. Empty hides it.

fields.label: Items
fields.description: One entry per line. title/end: a timeline clip per line. flow: a box per line, 'Name: detail'. hub: first line is the centre, the rest orbit it, 'Name: detail'. terminal: commands; lines starting '>' are output. code: first line is the file name, then the code. feed: 'Source: event' per line. timeline: 'Track: clip, clip' per line. stats: 'Number: label' tiles. cards: 'Name: detail' per card. split: two 'Heading: text' panels. quote: the quote. image: ignored, set Image instead.

fields.label: Image
fields.description: Optional image URL or embedded data URL. When set, the shot shows the image under the title.
